query:
SELECT calculation_id AS "calculation_id: CalculationId",
                   account_id AS "account_id: AccountId",
                   activation_sequence,
                   backfill_complete,
                   created_at
            FROM cala_calculation_attachments
            WHERE calculation_id = $1
              AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR account_id > $2)
            ORDER BY account_id
            LIMIT $3
